title.en: Why are Ukraine's military recruiters facing violence in their own country?
title.zh: 为什么乌克兰的军事征兵人员在本国面临暴力？

summary.en: A report from the National Police Service in Ukraine has documented over 600 assaults on military recruitment officers, noting a concerning increase in the severity of these aggressive incidents.
summary.zh: 乌克兰国家警察局的最新报告记录了迄今为止超过600起针对军事征兵人员的袭击事件，并警告称这种侵略行为已变得“越来越具威胁性”。

body.en:
Ukraine is struggling to mobilise men to fight in the war against Russia as the conflict enters into its fifth year.

The reasons many people are hesitant to sign up range from plain fear of the front line to a reluctance to fight in a war with no end in sight.

This has led to some Ukrainians violently lashing out at recruitment officers trying to forcibly conscript them.

The latest National Police Service report recorded more than 600 assaults on recruitment officers to date and warned that the aggression has become "increasingly threatening".

In April, several recruiters were stabbed, one fatally. And in Lviv this month, some 200 protesters surrounded officers attempting to detain a suspected draft dodger and smashed and overturned their car.

The riot made headlines as President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned violence against serving soldiers.
body.zh: 随着冲突进入第五个年头，乌克兰正在努力动员人员参加对俄罗斯的战争。 许多人犹豫是否报名的原因包括对前线的恐惧，以及不愿参加一场看不到尽头的战争。 这导致一些乌克兰人猛烈抨击试图强行征召他们入伍的征兵官员。 国家警察局最新报告记录了迄今为止超过 600 起针对招募官员的袭击事件，并警告说，这种袭击行为已变得“越来越具有威胁性”。 4 月，几名招聘人员被刺伤，其中一人死亡。本月在利沃夫，约 200 名抗议者包围了试图拘留一名涉嫌逃兵的警察，并砸毁并掀翻了他们的汽车。 这场骚乱成为头条新闻，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基谴责针对现役士兵的暴力行为。

reflection.en: In times of national crisis, internal tensions can rise, leading to conflict even among those facing a common challenge. This verse reminds us of the constant call to seek peace within our communities, striving for harmony even when circumstances are incredibly difficult. It encourages each person to contribute to a peaceful environment, as much as it is...
reflection.zh: 在国家危机时期，内部紧张局势可能加剧，甚至在面临共同挑战的人们之间也会引发冲突。这节经文提醒我们，要不断寻求社区内部的和平，即使在极其艰难的环境中也要努力实现和谐。它鼓励每个人尽其所能，为和平的环境做出贡献。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: BBC broadcaster Edward Stourton dies aged 68
title.zh: 英国广播公司播音员爱德华·斯图尔顿去世，享年68岁

summary.en: The BBC has announced the death of veteran broadcaster and journalist Edward Stourton at the age of 68. Stourton was known for presenting prominent current affairs programs, including Today and One O’Clock News.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司宣布，资深播音员兼记者爱德华·斯图尔顿去世，享年68岁。斯图尔顿以主持《今日》和《一点新闻》等知名时事节目而闻名。

body.en:
The BBC Radio 4 presenter was best known for fronting current affairs programmes including Today, World at One and its religious and ethical current affairs series Sunday.

He died on Saturday surrounded by his family after being diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2014, the BBC said in a statement.

Former colleagues paid tribute to the man they called an outstanding broadcaster.

“It’s far too soon to lose Ed,” said Jonathan Munro, who runs BBC News and Current Affairs. “I worked as his producer when he was ITN’s diplomatic editor – unflappable then and ever after. Many years later, I was listening to his superb analysis of the new pope for the BBC – another of his many areas of expertise.

“Not many broadcasters can present Today, BBC One’s One O’Clock News, The World at One and Sunday, but he did. He leaves a huge gap.”

Mohit Bakaya, the controller of BBC Radio 4, said Stourton was an “absolutely outstanding broadcaster”. He added: “He brought intelligence, authority and an extraordinary hinterland to everything he did. When Ed was behind the mic, whether on Sunday or the various news programmes he regularly presented for Radio 4, you felt you understood the world that little bit better. Our thoughts are with his family and friends at this sad time.”

Stourton had a distinguished career in broadcasting, working for the BBC and ITN, which produces Channel 4 News. He spent nearly a decade presenting Radio 4’s flagship Today programme, and also presented the One O’clock News and Any Questions, as well as Radio 4’s Sunday and BBC One’s Panorama.

He joined ITN from university in 1979 and became a founding member of Channel 4 News three years later. Starting out as a scriptwriter, he went on to cover foreign news, and became the programme’s first Washington correspondent in 1986, reporting on the final years of the Reagan presidency.

In 1988 he started a two-year stint as the BBC’s Paris correspondent, which ended when he rejoined ITN as diplomatic editor. He reported from Baghdad during the Gulf war, Bosnia during the siege of Sarajevo and from Moscow in the final days of the Soviet Union.

He returned to the BBC in 1993 and presented the One O’Clock News for six years. He also presented editions of Assignment during his time with the broadcaster and had his own Radio 4 phone-in programme, Call Ed Stourton. He joined the Today programme in 1999 and, having presented it, later became a regular contributor.

From 2009 Stourton began presenting The World at One and The World This Weekend.

He was a Roman Catholic and hosted Radio 4’s religious programme Sunday and BBC One’s The Heaven and Earth Show, as well as documentaries such as Absolute Truth, a four-part BBC Two series about the Catholic church.

body.zh: 这位 BBC 广播四台主持人以主持时事节目而闻名，包括《今日》、《世界同在》及其宗教和道德时事系列节目《星期日》。 BBC 在一份声明中称，他于 2014 年被诊断出患有前列腺癌，并于周六在家人的陪伴下去世。 前同事向这位被他们称为杰出广播员的人致敬。 “失去艾德还为时过早，”BBC 新闻与时事部负责人乔纳森·蒙罗 (Jonathan Munro) 说。 “当他担任 ITN 外交编辑时，我曾担任他的制片人，从那时起一直到此后，我都镇定自若。多年后，我在 BBC 上聆听他对新教皇的精彩分析，这是他众多专业领域中的另一个。 “没有多少广播公司可以播放《今日》、《BBC One 的一点新闻》、《世界一点》和《周日》，但他做到了。他留下了巨大的空白。” BBC 广播四台的总监莫希特·巴卡亚 (Mohit Bakaya) 表示，斯托顿是一位“绝对出色的广播公司”。他补充道：“他所做的一切都带来了智慧、权威和非凡的腹地。当艾德在麦克风后面时，无论是周日还是他定期为第四台广播电台主持的各种新闻节目，你都会觉得自己对这个世界有了更多的了解。在这个悲伤的时刻，我们的思念与他的家人和朋友同在。” 斯托顿在广播领域有着杰出的职业生涯，曾为 BBC 和制作第四频道新闻的 ITN 工作。他花了近十年的时间主持第四台的旗舰节目《今日》，还主持了《一点新闻》和《任何问题》，以及第四台的《周日》和《BBC One》的《全景》。 他于 1979 年从大学加入 ITN，并于三年后成为 Channel 4 News 的创始成员。他最初是一名编剧，后来报道外国新闻，并于 1986 年成为该节目第一位驻华盛顿记者，报道里根总统任期的最后几年。 1988 年，他开始担任 BBC 驻巴黎记者，为期两年，最后以外交编辑身份重新加入 ITN。他在海湾战争期间从巴格达、在萨拉热窝围困期间从波斯尼亚以及在苏联最后几天从莫斯科进行报道。 1993年，他重返BBC，并主持了六年的《一点钟新闻》。在广播公司任职期间，他还制作了《Assignment》的各个版本，并拥有自己的 Radio 4 电话节目《Call Ed Stourton》。他于 1999 年加入 Today 节目，并在演讲后成为一名定期撰稿人。 从 2009 年起，斯托顿开始展示《The World at One》和《The World This Weekend》。 他是一名罗马天主教徒，主持了第四台广播电台的宗教节目《Sunday》和 BBC One 的《天地秀》，以及纪录片《绝对真理》（Absolute Truth），这是 BBC 二台关于天主教会的四集系列节目。 他出生在尼日利亚，他的父亲在那里......

reflection.en: The news of Edward Stourton's passing reminds us that every life, however distinguished, eventually reaches its conclusion. For those who live with purpose and integrity, there is a quiet dignity in finishing the race and leaving a legacy of faithful work.
reflection.zh: 爱德华·斯图尔顿去世的消息提醒我们，无论多么杰出的人生，终将走到终点。对于那些有目标、正直地生活的人来说，跑完赛程并留下忠实工作的遗产，本身就有一种宁静的尊严。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Andy Burnham to become new prime minister and lay out ‘10-year plan’ for the UK in No 10 speech - UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为新首相，并在唐宁街10号发表演讲，阐述英国“十年计划”——英国政治直播

summary.en: Andy Burnham is set to become the new Prime Minister of the UK and will deliver a speech from No 10 Downing Street, outlining a 10-year plan for the country. This follows Keir Starmer's final speech from the same location.
summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为英国新首相，并将在唐宁街10号发表讲话，阐述英国的十年计划。此前，基尔·斯塔默已在同一地点发表了告别演说。

body.en:
Good morning. Today we are getting a new PM. It is the sixth time this has happened in just over a decade (Theresa May replaced David Cameron on 13 July 2016), and so in some respects there is nothing very new or surprising about this. Yet the process has been unusual. In the past, when parties in power have replaced a PM, generally they have opted for someone popular with their own MPs, but less popular than their predecessor with the public at large (Liz Truss, Theresa May, Gordon Brown), or for someone more popular with the public, but less liked by their own activists (John Major, Rishi Sunak). At the start of the year, anyone looking at polling would have concluded that the logical choice for Labour would have been to replace Keir Starmer with Andy Burnham. Labour is not always noted for taking decisions that will be electorally beneficial, but in this case that is what it has achieved. It has replaced a PM who had become an electoral millstone with one of the most admired politicians in the country, and with someone – for the moment at least – with his whole party behind him.

That may not be the case by the end of the day, after Burnham has named his cabinet. We’ll have to see. Here is Rowena Mason ’s overnight story about what to expect today.

Burnham has given an interview to the Times and, while it does not contain any big new announcements, it is full of intriguing clues as to how he will govern. Two in particular stand out.

First, Burnham said he would be setting out a “10-year plan” for the country. He also told the Times that this was a statement about the scale of his ambitions, not about how long he planned to stay as PM. Patrick Maguire , who interviewed Burnham, said:

This week [Burnham] will tell us of his “ten-year plan for the country”. Perhaps his premiership won’t last that long, he conceded. “I’m not saying that means I’m setting out to say I’m going to be here for ten years … it’s more that we’re not in the right place structurally, we’re not in the right place as a country. I think people can feel that.”

And, second, Burnham dismissed claims that he was an inherent tax raiser . He even suggested that he would like to reverse the freeze in the personal allowance that has functioned as a stealth tax, leading to people paying proportionally more tax every year as their pay goes up but the allowance doesn’t. Burnham told Maguire:

One thing I heard most on the doorsteps in Makerfield was frustration about the personal allowance , frozen at £12,570 … [That complaint] lodged in my mind.

Burnham did not commit to ending the freeze, which would cost billions. But he suggested he was not a kneejerk tax raiser. He told Maguire:

They’re just characterising me as a tax raiser. Well, again, it’s never that simplistic, is it?

body.zh: 早上好。今天我们迎来了一位新总理。这是十多年来第六次发生这种情况（特蕾莎·梅于 2016 年 7 月 13 日接替大卫·卡梅伦），因此从某些方面来看，这并没有什么新奇或令人惊讶的地方。然而这个过程却很不寻常。过去，当执政党更换首相时，通常会选择受本党议员欢迎但在广大公众中不如其前任受欢迎的人（利兹·特拉斯、特蕾莎·梅、戈登·布朗），或者更受公众欢迎但不太受本党活动人士喜欢的人（约翰·梅杰、里希·苏纳克）。今年年初，任何关注民意调查的人都会得出结论，工党的合理选择是用安迪·伯纳姆取代凯尔·斯塔默。工党并不总是因做出有利于选举的决定而闻名，但在这种情况下，这就是它所取得的成就。它取代了一位成为选举重担的总理，取而代之的是该国最受尊敬的政治家之一——至少目前如此——整个政党都支持他。 在伯纳姆任命内阁后，情况可能最终不会发生。我们得看看。以下是罗威娜·梅森 (Rowena Mason) 昨晚讲述的关于今天会发生什么的故事。 伯纳姆接受了《泰晤士报》的采访，虽然其中没有任何重大的新公告，但其中充满了关于他将如何执政的有趣线索。有两个特别突出。 首先，伯纳姆表示他将为该国制定一个“十年计划”。他还告诉《泰晤士报》，这是关于他的野心规模的声明，而不是关于他计划担任总理多久。采访伯纳姆的帕特里克·马奎尔说道： 本周[伯纳姆]将告诉我们他的“国家十年计划”。他承认，也许他的首相任期不会持续那么久。 “我并不是说这意味着我要在这里待十年……更多的是我们在结构上没有处于正确的位置，我们作为一个国家没有处于正确的位置。我认为人们可以感觉到这一点。” 其次，伯纳姆驳斥了有关他本质上是税收筹集者的说法。他甚至建议，他想扭转个人免税额的冻结，这种冻结起到了隐形税的作用，导致人们每年随着工资上涨而缴纳的税款成比例增加，但免税额却没有增加。伯纳姆告诉马奎尔： 我在梅克菲尔德家门口听到最多的一件事是对冻结在 12,570 英镑的个人津贴感到沮丧……[那个抱怨]留在了我的脑海里。 伯纳姆没有承诺结束冻结，这将花费数十亿美元。但他表示自己并不是下意识的增税者。他告诉马奎尔： 他们只是把我描述为一个征税者。好吧，再说一遍，事情从来没有那么简单，不是吗？ 最后的...

reflection.en: As a new Prime Minister steps into office with a long-term plan, the wisdom of Proverbs reminds us that a clear vision is essential for a nation's flourishing. Without purposeful guidance, societies can drift; with it, there is hope for stability and progress. May Yahweh grant leaders insight to chart a course that serves the common good.
reflection.zh: 随着新首相上任并提出十年计划，箴言的智慧提醒我们，清晰的愿景对国家的繁荣至关重要。没有有目的的指引，社会可能迷失方向；有了它，就有稳定和进步的希望。愿雅伟赐予领导者洞察力，为共同利益规划路线。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: ‘We need to talk about how difficult it is’: why one couple are pinning surrogacy hopes on Mexico
title.zh: “我们需要谈谈这有多难”：一对夫妇为何将代孕希望寄托在墨西哥

summary.en: Jules Von Hep and Mark Beverlo, who have been trying to become parents since 2020, are now seeking help abroad, specifically in Mexico, to pursue surrogacy. This decision highlights the increasing trend of overseas surrogacy, which also raises ethical debates and concerns about the risk of stateless babies.
summary.zh: 朱尔斯·冯·赫普和马克·贝弗洛自2020年以来一直努力成为父母，现在他们正在海外，特别是墨西哥寻求代孕帮助。这一决定凸显了海外代孕日益增长的趋势，同时也引发了伦理辩论和对无国籍婴儿风险的担忧。

body.en: Jules Von Hep and Mark Beverlo, who have been trying to become parents since 2020, are now seeking help abroad Rise in overseas surrogates ‘increases risk of stateless babies’ Why Mexico is at the heart of ethical debate over global surrogacy Jules Von Hep has wanted a baby ever since he can remember. For many people that dream is straightforward to realise – but, as a gay man, he has always known it would take years of saving and searching. The only way he can have a biological child is to use a surrogate, which costs tens of thousands of pounds, and it often takes years of searching to find the right match. For Von Hep, it has been an “incredibly painful, incredibly expensive” process. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自 2020 年以来，朱尔斯·冯·赫普 (Jules Von Hep) 和马克·贝弗洛 (Mark Beverlo) 一直在努力成为父母，现在正在国外寻求帮助海外代孕妈妈的增加“增加了无国籍婴儿的风险”。对于许多人来说，这个梦想很容易实现——但是，作为一名同性恋者，他一直都知道这需要多年的保存和寻找。他能拥有亲生孩子的唯一方法是使用代孕妈妈，这要花费数万英镑，而且往往需要数年时间才能找到合适的匹配对象。对于冯赫普来说，这是一个“极其痛苦、极其昂贵”的过程。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep human desire for children, as seen in this couple's journey, reflects the profound truth that children are a gift from Yahweh. While modern paths to parenthood can be complex and raise ethical questions, the longing itself speaks to the inherent value and blessing of new life. May all involved in such processes be guided by wisdom and compassion,...
reflection.zh: 这对夫妇对孩子的深切渴望，反映了孩子是雅伟所赐的宝贵产业这一深刻真理。虽然现代的生育途径可能复杂并引发伦理问题，但这种渴望本身就说明了新生命的内在价值和祝福。愿所有参与此类过程的人都能得到智慧和怜悯的指引，确保每个孩子的福祉和尊严。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Derryn Hinch remembered as ‘journalistic James Bond’ – as it happened
title.zh: 德林·欣奇被追忆为‘新闻界的詹姆斯·邦德’——事件回顾

summary.en: The Australian government is developing a national plan to implement stringent regulations on the use of artificial intelligence by government departments and agencies. These new rules are expected to extend to consumer protections and workplace applications of AI.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政府正在制定一项国家计划，对政府部门和机构使用人工智能实施严格规定。这些新规则预计将涵盖消费者保护和人工智能在工作场所的应用。

reflection.en: As governments worldwide grapple with the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, the need for careful foresight and protective measures becomes evident. reflection.zh: 随着全球各国政府努力应对人工智能的迅速发展，仔细的预见性和保护措施的需求变得显而易见。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，要预见潜在的危险并审慎行事，而不是盲目冒进。为人工智能的使用制定明确规则，体现了在不断发展的技术环境中维护人类福祉的承诺。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Iran vows not a ‘single drop’ of oil or gas will pass strait of Hormuz as US carries out ninth night of strikes – Middle East crisis live

summary.zh: 在美国部队人员死亡后，美军对伊朗目标进行了第九晚的打击，旨在结束战争的初步协议已经破裂。中东地区局势依然紧张，据报道又有一名美军人员丧生，霍尔木兹海峡附近一艘船只起火。

reflection.zh: 新闻中描述的不断升级的打击和报复，悲剧性地印证了“动刀的必死在刀下”这一古老警示。当刀剑被拔出时，伤害的循环往往会持续，导致更多的损失和苦难。雅伟呼召我们，即使在深刻的冲突中，也要寻求打破这些破坏性模式的道路。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.

title.en: The Tate brothers' international legal saga: The cases, charges and what comes next
title.zh: 泰特兄弟的国际法律纠纷：案件、指控及后续发展

summary.en: Self-described misogynist Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were arrested over the weekend in the US and face charges in multiple jurisdictions.
summary.zh: 自称厌女主义者的安德鲁·泰特和他的兄弟特里斯坦在美国被捕，并在多个司法管辖区面临指控。

body.en:
On Sunday, social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami in the United States, after authorities in the United Kingdom issued 38 new charges against the brothers, deepening the pair's international legal saga and adding further complication to an already fraught legal situation.

The United Kingdom's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has charged the brothers — who deny all wrongdoing — with fresh counts of rape, actual bodily harm, and human trafficking.

The new accusations add to a mountain of serious charges against the pair and could lead to the brothers' extradition from the US, assuming it is approved by the US state department.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate are dual US-UK citizens who have risen to prominence as social media influencers.

Andrew started his career in public life as a kickboxer and has gone on to become a prominent figure in the online 'manosphere' space, describing himself as a misogynist and encouraging his more than 10 million followers to follow in his footsteps.

He primarily posts on X, having been banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram for violating hate speech guidelines.

Stephanie Wescott, a lecturer in humanities and social science at Monash University, described Andrew as the "main character" of this content, while his brother Tristan is more of a "side figure".

She said the Tates have turned disrespecting and abusing women into a business model that glamorises male dominance, 'teaching' men how to emulate them through an online academy.

"[They promote] anti-feminism, anti-gender-equality, and hyper-masculinity or, you know, 'men being men' or men going back to a type of manhood that no longer exists," she said.

"One of their business models has been to train other young men into becoming the sort of influencers that they claim that they are.

"Part of that business model has also been to exploit and harm the girls and women around you and to use their images as currency to sell online — we know Australian men have signed up for these services.

The pair have also expressed support for US President Donald Trump, and Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, spoke out against the brothers' detention in Romania in 2023.

"The other layer to this is, of course, that they have this incredible political proximity to Donald Trump," Wescott said.

In 2025, Andrew Tate said he was "very close with the Trump family". Trump himself has said little about the Tates, however.

"They have been supported and aided by adjacent figures, podcasters such as Joe Rogan and others like him," Wescott continued.

body.zh: 周日，社交媒体影响者安德鲁·泰特 (Andrew Tate) 和特里斯坦·泰特 (Tristan Tate) 在美国迈阿密被捕，此前英国当局对兄弟俩提出 38 项新指控，加深了两人的国际法律纠纷，并使本已充满麻烦的法律局势进一步复杂化。 英国皇家检察署（CPS）对这对否认所有不当行为的兄弟提出了新的强奸、实际身体伤害和人口贩运罪名。 新的指控增加了针对这两兄弟的大量严重指控，如果得到美国国务院的批准，可能会导致兄弟俩被从美国引渡。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 安德鲁·泰特 (Andrew Tate) 和他的兄弟特里斯坦·泰特 (Tristan Tate) 拥有美国和英国双重国籍，他们已成为社交媒体影响者。 安德鲁的职业生涯始于一名跆拳道运动员，后来成为在线“男性圈”领域的知名人物，他将自己描述为厌恶女性的人，并鼓励他的超过 1000 万粉丝追随他的脚步。 他主要在 X 上发帖，因违反仇恨言论准则而被 YouTube、TikTok 和 Instagram 禁止。 莫纳什大学人文与社会科学讲师斯蒂芬妮·韦斯科特(Stephanie Wescott)将安德鲁描述为该内容的“主角”，而他的弟弟特里斯坦更多的是“配角”。 她说，泰特夫妇将不尊重和虐待女性变成了一种美化男性主导地位的商业模式，通过在线学院“教导”男性如何效仿她们。 “[他们宣扬]反女权主义、反性别平等和超男子气概，或者，你知道，‘男人就是男人’，或者男人回归一种不再存在的男子气概，”她说。 “他们的商业模式之一是培训其他年轻人成为他们声称的那种有影响力的人。 “这种商业模式的一部分也是剥削和伤害你周围的女孩和妇女，并使用她们的图像作为货币在网上销售——我们知道澳大利亚男性已经注册了这些服务。 两人还表达了对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持，而特朗普的长子小唐纳德·特朗普则公开反对 2023 年两兄弟在罗马尼亚被拘留。 “当然，另一方面，他们与唐纳德·特朗普有着令人难以置信的政治接近，”韦斯科特说。 2025年，安德鲁·泰特表示，他“与特朗普家族关系非常密切”。然而，特朗普本人却很少谈论泰茨夫妇。 “他们得到了邻近人物、乔·罗根等播客和其他像他一样的人的支持和帮助，”韦斯科特继续说道。 兄弟俩搬到罗马尼亚...

reflection.en: The news of Andrew Tate's arrest reminds us that public personas and ideologies, especially those rooted in pride and contempt, often face eventual accountability. Yahweh's word warns that a haughty spirit precedes a fall, suggesting that actions and attitudes have consequences that justice will ultimately address.
reflection.zh: 安德鲁·泰特被捕的消息提醒我们，公众形象和意识形态，特别是那些根植于骄傲和蔑视的，最终常常会面临问责。雅伟的话语警告说，心骄气傲走在败坏以先，这表明行为和态度都会带来后果，而公义最终会处理这些后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Nigel Farage's unusual UK by-election now has an Australian candidate
title.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇不同寻常的英国补选现在有了一位澳大利亚候选人

summary.en: Nigel Farage is set to contest the Clacton by-election, where he will face a diverse field of candidates, including Count Binface and Australian Daniel Pocock.
summary.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇将在克拉克顿补选中参选，他将与包括“垃圾桶伯爵”和澳大利亚人丹尼尔·波科克在内的多位候选人竞争。

body.en:
There's a man with a bin on his head, three people representing the Monster Raving Loony Party, Nigel Farage and an Australian — now all vying for the seat vacated by the Reform UK leader in a crucial by-election.

The Clacton by-election, triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Farage over a donations scandal, has attracted all sorts of profiles to the mix.

Farage, who is under investigation over millions of pounds' worth of undeclared gifts and donations from wealthy backers, quit parliament earlier this month to trigger a by-election, but said he would re-contest his seat . The Reform UK leader said he wanted voters in his electoral district in south-east England to judge his actions, not what he said was a liberal "establishment" bent on discrediting him.

Farage is widely expected to win the seat again, and is the only mainstream candidate running, after other major parties said they would refuse to take part in what they characterised as a stunt.

A number of joke candidates — including Count Binface and another called 'Nick the Incredible Flying Brick' — are vying for the seat, along with 20 independents.

Pocock is a Swiss-Irish-Australian software engineer who describes himself as an "expert on cybersecurity, open source software [and] cryptocurrencies".

According to his website, he was born in the Melbourne suburb of Coburg before moving to rural Wandong. He graduated from the University of Melbourne in 2002 with a Bachelor of Computer Science.

While studying, he joined the National Union of Students and used his technical skills to assist websites for early social causes. He built a website opposing the death penalty after Schapelle Corby's arrest in Bali on drug trafficking charges.

He moved to Europe after graduation and worked for companies like Barclays Capital, Thomson Reuters, and UBS.

In a press release announcing his candidacy, Pocock says he was spurred to nominate himself for Clacton by the prospect of "novelty candidates".

"If the Essex Lion was to appear on the ballot paper, I suspect it would have an equally good chance of winning. I have yet to see a single report about the real, day-to-day issues facing residents of the district," he said.

"In a parody of this situation, I have chosen the codename Pocock-on-Sea for the operation to unleash an Australian upon London's Establishment."

Pocock said Farage has proposed many Australian policies to replace UK ones, though he did not specify which. Farage has previously outlined an immigration plan that echoes Australia's offshore processing system, which has been heavily criticised by human rights...
body.zh: 一名男子头上顶着一个垃圾箱，三名代表怪物狂欢党的人、奈杰尔·法拉奇和一名澳大利亚人——现在都在争夺英国改革派领导人在一次关键补选中空出的席位。 克拉克顿补选是由法拉奇因捐款丑闻在议会辞职而引发的，吸引了各种各样的人士参与其中。 法拉奇因来自富有支持者的价值数百万英镑的未申报礼物和捐赠而受到调查，他于本月早些时候退出议会以引发补选，但表示他将重新竞选席位。这位改革英国领导人表示，他希望英格兰东南部选区的选民来评判他的行为，而不是他所说的一心要抹黑他的自由派“建制派”。 人们普遍预计法拉奇将再次赢得席位，并且是唯一参加竞选的主流候选人，此前其他主要政党表示将拒绝参加他们所说的噱头。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 许多笑话候选人——包括宾菲斯伯爵和另一位被称为“不可思议的飞砖尼克”的候选人——正在与 20 名独立人士一起争夺这个席位。 Pocock 是一位瑞士、爱尔兰和澳大利亚混血的软件工程师，他将自己描述为“网络安全、开源软件[和]加密货币方面的专家”。 根据他的网站，他出生在墨尔本郊区的科堡，后来搬到万东农村。他于 2002 年毕业于墨尔本大学，获得计算机科学学士学位。 在学习期间，他加入了全国学生联合会，并利用自己的技术技能为早期社会事业的网站提供帮助。沙佩尔·科比因贩毒罪名在巴厘岛被捕后，他建立了一个反对死刑的网站。 毕业后，他移居欧洲，曾在巴克莱资本、汤森路透和瑞银等公司工作。 波科克在宣布参选的新闻稿中表示，由于“新奇候选人”的前景，他提名自己为克拉克顿议员。 “如果埃塞克斯雄狮出现在选票上，我怀疑它也有同样好的获胜机会。我还没有看到任何关于该地区居民面临的真实日常问题的报告，”他说。 “为了模仿这种情况，我选择了“Pocock-on-Sea”作为这次行动的代号，将一名澳大利亚人释放到伦敦的建制派上。” 波科克表示，法拉奇提出了许多澳大利亚政策来取代英国政策，但他没有具体说明是哪些政策。法拉奇此前概述了一项移民计划，该计划与澳大利亚的离岸处理系统相呼应，该系统受到了人权方面的严厉批评……

As various candidates present their visions, the challenge is to discern which voices truly contribute to the well-being and stability of the people. reflection.zh: 在任何选举中，公民都被呼召思考谁能为他们的社区提供明智的指导。当不同的候选人提出他们的愿景时，挑战在于辨别哪些声音真正有助于人民的福祉和稳定。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，一个民族在健全的忠告指引下才能兴盛。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.

title.en: Spanish and Argentinian fans react outside World Cup final

reflection.en: The World Cup final evokes powerful emotions, from ecstatic joy to profound disappointment, as fans experience the transient nature of victory and defeat. Yahweh's word reminds us that while we strive for earthly crowns, their glory is perishable. This perspective can help us navigate both triumph and loss with a deeper sense of what truly endures.
reflection.zh: 世界杯决赛激发出强烈的情感，从狂喜到深切的失望，球迷们体验着胜利与失败的短暂性。雅伟的话语提醒我们，当我们为地上的冠冕而努力时，它们的荣耀却是会朽坏的。这种视角能帮助我们以对真正永恒之事的更深理解来面对成功与失败。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Food delivery rider wins China's top literary prize
title.zh: 快递小哥荣获中国最高文学奖

summary.en: Wang Jibing is among blue-collar Chinese workers gaining wider attention for their literary works.
summary.zh: 王计兵是获得广泛关注的中国蓝领工人之一，他们的文学作品备受瞩目。

body.en:
A collection of poems, some scribbled on slips of paper between food deliveries, has won Wang Jibing one of China's top literary honours.

Low Flight, inspired by the everyday challenges delivery riders face, has bagged the Lu Xun Literary Prize - named after a writer who has been referred to as the father of modern Chinese literature.

Wang, 56, who became a delivery rider around 2019, gained traction on social media for his poems and essays.

He is part of a growing group of blue-collar workers who are being celebrated for their literary works, which offer a glimpse into the pressures that they face in China's massive gig economy.

For Wang, the prestigious literary prize comes after a few difficult decades as an odd job worker.

"I held my breath and felt extremely nervous… Once it was revealed, everything was settled," Wang told state media outlet Global Times on 15 July, when news broke that he had won the award - adding that the media attention around him had created a lot of mental pressure on him.

The monetary awards for recipients of the Lu Xun Literary Prize are not publicly announced - though as of 2014 it stood at 100,000 Chinese yuan ($14,800; £11,000).

Born in Jiangsu province, Wang left school as a teenager due to financial hardship at home. He took on various jobs, from construction to scavenging for waste and selling things at a street stall, before becoming a food deliveryman.

But his love for reading persisted, and over the last decade he has been posting his own poems and essays on social media.

In 2022, one of his poems, titled Man in a Hurry, went viral online. It was inspired by a incident in 2019, in which he spent hours on a frustrating delivery after a customer entered the wrong address.

In 2023 he published his first poetry collection, Man in a Hurry: Poems of a Food Delivery Rider.

Despite winning the award, Wang told the outlet he had no intention of quitting his job, adding that he planned to work until he turns 60.

"Financially I don't need this job to make a living, but I love the vibe of the work and it keeps me fit," said the Global Times report. "I want a down-to-earth life and the award will never change who I am."

Low Flight, published in 2024, is a collection of poems inspired by interviews and surveys that Wang conducted with around 200 delivery riders.

"Who says spreading your wings means flying high? Flying low is also flying," goes one of the lines in his poems.

His win comes as a growing number of blue worker collars in China have in recent years been making their mark in the literary world.

body.zh: 王吉兵的一本诗集（其中一些是在送餐期间写在纸条上的）为他赢得了中国最高文学荣誉之一。 《低空飞行》的灵感来自于外卖骑手每天面临的挑战，它获得了鲁迅文学奖——以一位被称为中国现代文学之父的作家的名字命名。 王现年 56 岁，2019 年左右成为一名送货骑手，他的诗歌和散文在社交媒体上受到关注。 他是越来越多的蓝领工人群体中的一员，这些工人因其文学作品而受到赞誉，这让人们得以一窥他们在中国庞大的零工经济中面临的压力。 对于王来说，享有盛誉的文学奖是在他作为打零工经历了几十年艰难的生活之后获得的。 7月15日，当他获奖的消息传出时，王告诉官方媒体《环球时报》：“我屏住呼吸，感到非常紧张……一旦揭晓，一切就都解决了。”他还补充说，周围媒体的关注给他带来了很大的精神压力。 鲁迅文学奖获奖者的奖金并未公开公布，但截至 2014 年，奖金为 10 万元人民币（14,800 美元；11,000 英镑）。 王出生于江苏省，青少年时期因家庭经济困难而辍学。在成为一名送餐员之前，他从事过各种工作，从建筑到清理垃圾，再到在街边摊上卖东西。 但他对阅读的热爱始终如一，在过去的十年里，他一直在社交媒体上发布自己的诗歌和散文。 2022年，他的一首诗《匆忙的男人》在网上疯传。它的灵感来自 2019 年的一次事件，当时一位顾客输入了错误的地址，他花了几个小时处理令人沮丧的送货事宜。 2023年，他出版了第一部诗集《匆忙的人：送餐骑手的诗》。 尽管获奖，王告诉媒体他无意辞职，并补充说他计划工作到 60 岁。 《环球时报》报道称：“从经济上来说，我不需要这份工作来谋生，但我喜欢这份工作的氛围，它让我保持健康。” “我想要脚踏实地的生活，这个奖项永远不会改变我是谁。” 《低空飞行》于 2024 年出版，是一本诗集，灵感来自于王对约 200 名送货骑手进行的采访和调查。 “谁说展翅高飞？低飞也是飞翔。”他的诗中有这样一句话。 他的获奖之际，近年来，越来越多的中国蓝领工人在文学界崭露头角。 前快递员胡安彦于 2023 年出版的回忆录《我在北京送包裹》在中国成为畅销书，也引起了海外媒体的关注。该回忆录的英文译本于去年出版......

reflection.en: This story of a food delivery rider winning a top literary prize reminds us that dedication and talent can emerge from any walk of life. It encourages us to approach all our work, whether daily tasks or creative pursuits, with diligence and a sense of purpose, knowing Yahweh values our efforts.
reflection.zh: 这位快递小哥荣获文学大奖的故事提醒我们，无论从事何种职业，只要用心投入，才华和卓越都能绽放。它鼓励我们以勤勉和使命感对待所有的工作，无论是日常琐事还是创意追求，因为雅伟看重我们所有的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Test that found source of US explosive diarrhoea outbreak was false positive, health officials say
title.zh: 卫生官员称，此前发现美国爆发性腹泻疫情源头的检测结果为假阳性

summary.en: Health officials have announced that a test previously identified as the source of a US explosive diarrhea outbreak was a false positive. The Food and Drug Administration's update means the exact origin of the parasite remains unknown.
summary.zh: 卫生官员表示，此前被认定为美国爆发性腹泻疫情源头的检测结果为假阳性。美国食品药品监督管理局的最新消息意味着这种寄生虫的确切来源仍然不明。

body.en:
Tests of an iceberg lettuce sample for the parasite that has caused an explosive diarrhoea outbreak affecting thousands of people in the US produced a false positive, officials have now said.

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on Saturday reported that the sample from food supplier Taylor Farms, which supplies the Taco Bell food chain, had tested positive for cyclospora.

It said on Sunday that it had re-reviewed the sample and reported the false-positive to Taylor Farms, adding it "continues working with the firm to ensure product implicated in this outbreak has been removed from the market".

No deaths have been reported from cyclosporiasis infections, but at least 94 people have been hospitalised.

Taylor Farms announced on Friday that it was voluntarily removing all iceberg lettuce from the US market sourced from central Mexico, and issued a list of affected products.

The FDA reported the following day that the positive sample was taken from a product not part of Taylor Farms' current recall announced on Friday.

A recall differs from a voluntary product removal in that it requires a company to notify customers and recover affected products from commerce, making it a broader and more costly corrective action.

The FDA said it collected the sample during targeted surveillance of the import as part of its investigation into the outbreak.

It said on Sunday: "Due to the complexity in detection of Cyclospora, FDA laboratory experts re-reviewed the sample results and have concluded that the finding does not represent true amplification and should be considered a false positive," the FDA said in Sunday's statement.

Symptoms of the foodborne illness can take up to two weeks to present. They include watery diarrhoea that lasts for days, sudden weight loss, and a loss of appetite.

Thousands of people have been infected with Cyclospora linked to iceberg lettuce supplied by Taylor Farms and sold at Taco Bell locations in at least five states, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

The CDC advises not to eat shredded iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell locations in Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and West Virginia.

The fast food chain said it had completed its removal of affected Taylor Farms lettuce from its restaurants.

In a statement, Taylor Farms said it has "stopped receiving product from the implicated lot, suspended distribution of the iceberg lettuce from Central Mexico, notified [its] customers and [is] continuing to work with the FDA, CDC, and state authorities".

The lettuce was recalled , external in 27 states. It also includes Marketside-branded iceberg lettuce sold at Walmart locations in 15 states, according to the FDA.
body.zh: 官员们表示，对卷心生菜样本进行的寄生虫检测出现了假阳性，这种寄生虫导致了美国数千人爆发性腹泻爆发。 美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 周六报告称，为 Taco Bell 食品链供货的食品供应商泰勒农场 (Taco Bell) 的样本检测出环孢子虫呈阳性。 该公司周日表示，已重新审查了样本，并向泰勒农场报告了假阳性结果，并补充说，“将继续与该公司合作，确保与此次疫情有关的产品已从市场上撤出”。 目前尚未有因环孢子虫病感染导致死亡的报道，但至少有 94 人已住院治疗。 泰勒农场周五宣布，自愿从美国市场上撤下所有来自墨西哥中部的卷心生菜，并发布了受影响产品清单。 FDA 第二天报告称，阳性样本取自泰勒农场周五宣布的当前召回范围内的产品。 召回与自愿产品下架的不同之处在于，召回要求公司通知客户并从商业中回收受影响的产品，这使其成为更广泛且成本更高的纠正措施。 FDA 表示，作为疫情调查的一部分，它在进口有针对性的监测过程中收集了样本。 FDA 在周日的声明中表示：“由于检测环孢子虫的复杂性，FDA 实验室专家重新审查了样本结果，并得出结论，这一发现并不代表真正的扩增，应被视为假阳性。” 食源性疾病的症状可能需要两周的时间才会出现。这些症状包括持续数天的水样腹泻、体重突然减轻和食欲不振。 据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 称，数千人感染了与泰勒农场供应的卷心生菜有关的环孢子虫，该生菜在至少五个州的塔可钟门店出售。 疾病预防控制中心建议不要食用印第安纳州、肯塔基州、密歇根州、俄亥俄州和西弗吉尼亚州的 Taco Bell 门店供应的卷心生菜丝。 这家快餐连锁店表示，已完成从其餐厅移除受影响的泰勒农场生菜的工作。 泰勒农场在一份声明中表示，该公司已“停止接收涉案批次的产品，暂停从墨西哥中部配送卷心生菜，通知其客户，并继续与 FDA、CDC 和州当局合作”。 该生菜在 27 个州被召回。据 FDA 称，其中还包括在 15 个州的沃尔玛门店销售的 Marketside 品牌卷心生菜。

reflection.en: This news reminds us that even with advanced science, initial findings can be misleading, and the path to truth often requires careful re-evaluation. It highlights the importance of discernment, encouraging us to consider all information prudently rather than accepting every initial report.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，即使在先进的科学领域，初步发现也可能具有误导性，通往真相的道路往往需要仔细的重新评估。它强调了辨别力的重要性，鼓励我们审慎地考量所有信息，而不是接受每一个初步报告。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Norway opens new memorial for victims of 2011 massacre
title.zh: 挪威为2011年布雷维克大屠杀受害者揭幕新纪念碑

summary.en: Norway has opened a new memorial in its capital, Oslo, for the victims of the 2011 Breivik massacre. The artwork was unveiled on Sunday, ahead of the 15th anniversary of the attack.
summary.zh: 挪威在首都奥斯陆为2011年布雷维克大屠杀的受害者揭幕了一座新的纪念碑。这件艺术品于周日揭幕，以纪念袭击事件发生15周年。

body.en:
Norway has opened a new memorial for the 77 victims of the country's deadliest terror attack in peacetime, days before its 15th anniversary.

On 22 July 2011, neo-Nazi Anders Breivik killed eight people with a car bomb in Oslo and shot dead another 69 - mostly teenagers - at a youth camp on Utoeya island. Hundreds more were injured in Norway's worst atrocity in recent history.

On Sunday, survivors and relatives of the victims gathered in Oslo for the unveiling of a large artwork showing a bird native to Utoeya island.

The artist said the work was two-fold - to remember the victims and to engage the public in an act of democratic resilience against far-right ideologies that inspired the attack.

The contemporary artwork features a huge blue steel frame supporting a 12-metre (39ft) high stone mosaic that depicts a small wading bird, as well as straw and sticks reflected in the water.

Called Upholding, the memorial is located in Oslo's renovated government district, close to the location of the bomb blast that started the 2011 attack.

The artist Matias Faldbakken said he had seen the bird on Utoeya island. Many of those killed on the island were teenagers involved with the Norwegian Labour Party's youth wing, the AUF.

"July 22, 2011 was a brutal attack not only on individuals, but also on our democracy," said Merete Stamneshagen, head of a support group for victims and survivors, quoted by the AFP news agency.

Norway's Crown Prince Haakon and government officials also attended the inauguration ceremony in Oslo on Sunday.

Haakon also visited the new 22 July Centre - Norway's national memorial and education centre dedicated to the attacks.

In 2012, Breivik was sentenced to 21 years in jail, the maximum a court in Norway can impose, though it can be extended for as long as he is deemed a threat.

In 2016, he partially won his human rights case against Norway before it was overturned the following year .

In 2022, he failed in his bid for parole, with the court ruling he had not changed and remained a risk to society. In 2024, he unsuccessfully sued the government over claims of isolation, as he is kept separately from other prisoners for security reasons.

body.zh: 距离该国和平时期最严重的恐怖袭击事件 15 周年纪念日前几天，挪威为该国和平时期最严重的恐怖袭击事件的 77 名受害者开设了一座新的纪念碑。 2011 年 7 月 22 日，新纳粹分子安德斯·布雷维克 (Anders Breivik) 在奥斯陆用汽车炸弹炸死 8 人，并在于托亚岛 (Utoeya) 的一个青年营枪杀了另外 69 人，其中大部分是青少年。挪威近代史上最严重的暴行造成数百人受伤。 周日，幸存者和受害者亲属聚集在奥斯陆，为一幅大型艺术品揭幕，该艺术品展示了于托亚岛的一种鸟类。 这位艺术家表示，该作品有两个目的：纪念受害者，并让公众参与到民主恢复行动中，反对激发袭击的极右意识形态。 这件当代艺术作品采用巨大的蓝色钢框架支撑着 12 米（39 英尺）高的石马赛克，马赛克描绘了一只小型涉水鸟，以及倒映在水中的稻草和棍棒。 这座纪念馆名为“Upholding”，位于奥斯陆经过翻修的政府区，靠近引发 2011 年袭击的炸弹爆炸地点。 艺术家马蒂亚斯·法尔巴肯 (Matias Faldbakken) 表示，他曾在于托亚岛见过这种鸟。岛上遇难者中有许多是参与挪威工党青年翼 AUF 的青少年。 法新社援引受害者和幸存者支持组织负责人梅雷特·斯塔姆内沙根 (Merete Stamneshagen) 的话说：“2011 年 7 月 22 日，这不仅是对个人的残酷攻击，也是对我们民主的残酷攻击。” 挪威王储哈康和政府官员也出席了周日在奥斯陆举行的就职典礼。 哈康还参观了新的 7 月 22 日中心——挪威专门纪念袭击事件的国家纪念和教育中心。 2012年，布雷维克被判处21年监禁，这是挪威法院可以判处的最高刑期，不过只要他被视为威胁，刑期就可以延长。 2016年，他在针对挪威的人权诉讼中部分获胜，但次年该案被推翻。 2022年，他申请假释失败，法院裁定他没有改变，仍然对社会构成风险。 2024 年，他因安全原因与其他囚犯分开监禁，起诉政府要求隔离，但未成功。 挪威于托亚大屠杀：五年过去了。视频，00:03:28 挪威于托亚大屠杀：五年过去了

reflection.en: The unveiling of a memorial for those lost in a tragic massacre serves as a poignant reminder of profound human suffering. In such moments of collective grief, Yahweh's promise that He will wipe away every tear and that death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more, offers a deep well of comfort and hope. It reminds us that even the deepest wounds will...
reflection.zh: 为在悲惨大屠杀中逝去的受害者揭幕纪念碑，是对人类深重苦难的沉痛提醒。在这样集体悲痛的时刻，雅伟应许祂将擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡、悲哀、哭号、疼痛，这提供了深刻的安慰与盼望。它提醒我们，即使是最深的创伤，有一天也将在祂面前得到医治。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: 'Impossible': Nauru community detainees say Australian funds not enough to buy food with
title.zh: 瑙鲁社区被拘留者称澳大利亚资金不足以购买食物，称“不可能”

summary.en: Detainees in the Nauru community report that the funds provided by Australia are insufficient to cover basic necessities, forcing them to choose between purchasing food, water, or internet access.
summary.zh: 瑙鲁社区的被拘留者报告称，澳大利亚提供的资金不足以支付基本生活必需品，迫使他们在购买食物、水或网络之间做出选择。

body.en:
Asylum seekers being detained within the community in Nauru are struggling to buy enough food and are being forced to choose between eating and paying for other necessities.

The difficulties are being driven by a mix of high living costs and low income support, according to a new report by the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre.

Of 78 people interviewed for the report, 99 per cent said they couldn't afford to buy enough food with their current allowance.

On top of that, 68 per cent said they rarely or never had access to fresh fruit, vegetables and meat, and 82 per cent said they didn't have easy access to free, clean drinking water.

Community detainees live on $260 a fortnight to cover all of their basic needs outside accommodation.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The group have been sent to the tiny island nation under Australia's long-standing policy of offshore processing for asylum-seekers who arrive by boat.

Speaking anonymously, detainees consistently told the centre the allowance wasn't enough to sustain them, forcing them to decide between buying food and other necessities like clothing and internet access.

Many were running out of money before their next payment and were forced to reduce meals or go without food altogether.

"With food we have to compromise, if you buy vegetables you can't afford rice. If you buy meat, you can't afford fruit," one said.

"The money is not enough because everything is expensive here — rice, fish, we cannot buy any fruit here, internet for $100 per month, how is it possible to survive?" said another.

Nauru struggles with food insecurity due to its remote location and limited local agriculture, with perishable food flown in weekly and often selling out quickly or being prohibitively expensive.

With no rivers or freshwater lakes, the island also relies primarily on rainwater harvesting and desalination, meaning water shortages are common during times of low rainfall, forcing those who live there to turn to bottled water.

Asylum seekers in the community often struggle due to their lack of orientation or local knowledge as to how food systems work, as well as infrequent transportation to and from markets, the resource centre said.

As of 31 May, there were 101 people seeking asylum in Nauru, 91 of whom were in community accommodation.

The majority of those in detention in Nauru were young to middle-aged men from south and east Asia.

The group of asylum seekers are separate from a group of hundreds of former immigration detainees, known as the NZYQ cohort, sent to Nauru from Australia after the High Court in 2024 ruled indefinite detention to be unlawful.

body.zh: 被拘留在瑙鲁社区内的寻求庇护者正在努力购买足够的食物，并被迫在吃饭和支付其他必需品之间做出选择。 根据寻求庇护者资源中心的一份新报告，高生活成本和低收入支持共同造成了这些困难。 在接受该报告采访的 78 人中，99% 的人表示，他们目前的津贴买不起足够的食物。 除此之外，68% 的人表示他们很少或从未获得新鲜水果、蔬菜和肉类，82% 的人表示他们不容易获得免费、干净的饮用水。 社区被拘留者每两周的生活费为 260 美元，以满足他们在住宿之外的所有基本需求。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 根据澳大利亚对乘船抵达的寻求庇护者的长期离岸处理政策，这批人被送往这个小岛国。 匿名的被拘留者一直告诉中心，这些津贴不足以维持他们的生活，迫使他们在购买食物和其他必需品（例如衣服和互联网）之间做出决定。 许多人在下一次付款之前就已经花光了钱，被迫减少膳食或完全不吃东西。 “在食物方面我们必须妥协，如果你买蔬菜，你就买不起大米。如果你买肉，你就买不起水果，”一位人士说。 “钱不够，因为这里什么东西都贵——米、鱼，我们在这里买不到任何水果，每月100美元的互联网，怎么可能生存？”另一个人说道。 由于地处偏远，当地农业有限，瑙鲁面临粮食不安全问题，每周都会有易腐烂的食品空运过来，但往往很快就会卖完，或者价格昂贵得令人望而却步。 该岛没有河流或淡水湖，主要依靠雨水收集和海水淡化，这意味着在降雨量少的时候，缺水很常见，迫使居住在那里的人们转向瓶装水。 资源中心表示，社区中的寻求庇护者常常因为缺乏对粮食系统如何运作的指导或当地知识以及往返市场的交通不频繁而陷入困境。 截至 5 月 31 日，共有 101 人在瑙鲁寻求庇护，其中 91 人住在社区住宿中。 瑙鲁的大部分被拘留者是来自南亚和东亚的年轻至中年男子。 这群寻求庇护者与数百名前移民被拘留者（被称为 NZYQ 群体）分开，在 2024 年高等法院裁定无限期拘留非法后，他们从澳大利亚被送往瑙鲁。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载...

reflection.en: The struggle of detainees on Nauru to afford basic food and water highlights a profound human need, reminding us of Yahweh's call to share with the hungry and provide for the displaced. This situation challenges us to consider our responsibility to ensure that even the most vulnerable among us have access to life's essentials.
reflection.zh: 瑙鲁被拘留者为购买基本食物和水而挣扎的困境，凸显了人类的深切需求，提醒我们雅伟呼召我们与饥饿者分享，并为流离失所者提供帮助。这种情况促使我们思考，我们有责任确保即使是最脆弱的人也能获得生活必需品。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Algeria seeks larger EU energy role amid regional tensions
title.zh: 阿尔及利亚在地区紧张局势中寻求更大的欧盟能源角色

summary.en: Algeria and Germany have agreed to strengthen their energy partnership following President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's visit to Berlin. This agreement comes as Algeria continues to face internal challenges, including tensions related to Western Sahara and broader instability across the Sahel region.
summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩近期访问柏林后，阿尔及利亚与德国同意深化能源合作。然而，阿尔及利亚在国内仍面临紧张局势，包括西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定。

body.en:
Algeria and Germany agreed to deepen energy ties during President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's recent visit to Berlin. But Algiers is still grappling with tensions at home, over Western Sahara and instability in the Sahel.

For Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, this week's visit to Berlin marked his first official trip to Germany since he was elected president in 2019. The two-day visit was highlighted in a joint statement with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, in which the two leaders emphasized "the quality of cooperation" between their countries and pledged to deepen long-term energy cooperation.

" Algeria is a central partner for Europe's energy security. Natural gas supplies and cooperation on renewable energies are to be expanded. In the long term, it is about establishing a southern hydrogen corridor — from North Africa to Germany," Cerstin Gammelin, the spokesperson for German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier posted on X on Thursday.

Algeria is home to Africa's second-largest proven natural gas reserves after Nigeria . It is also Africa's largest natural gas producer. On July 2, Algeria's state-owned energy company Sonatrach delivered the first shipment of liquefied natural gas (LNG) directly to Germany's Wilhelmshaven 1 floating LNG import terminal. A direct pipeline to Germany would eliminate the need for liquefaction, LNG shipping and regasification for those volumes. This could reduce transport costs for gas deliveries, as is already the case with Algeria's two existing pipelines to Italy  and Spain .

"The war in Iran and the disruption of oil exports via the Strait of Hormuz have reinforced Algeria's energy importance," said Alice Gower, director of geopolitics and security at the London-based consulting firm Azure Strategy.

"Although Algeria cannot replace Gulf supplies , its pipeline gas reaches southern Europe without passing through Gulf shipping lanes, offering European governments supply diversification at a time of renewed concern about energy security," she said.

This view is echoed by Hafed Al-Ghwell, director of the North Africa, Mediterranean and the Sahel program at the Washington-based think tank Stimson Center. Al-Ghwell told DW he recently met with Algeria's foreign minister and members of the cabinet.

"You can sense very clearly that there is the political will at the highest level of government that Algeria needs to take advantage of what is happening globally as well as its unique position as a major gas producer," he said.

Algeria's value for Europe extends well beyond gas, Gower pointed out. "Algiers offers cooperation on counterterrorism, migration and Mediterranean stability," she told DW.

For years, Algeria has cooperated  with European countries on ...
body.zh: 阿尔及利亚和德国在总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特本最近访问柏林期间同意深化能源关系。但阿尔及尔仍在努力应对国内紧张局势、西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定局势。 对于阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩来说，本周对柏林的访问是他自 2019 年当选总统以来首次对德国进行正式访问。与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨的联合声明强调了为期两天的访问，两位领导人在声明中强调了两国之间的“合作质量”，并承诺深化长期能源合作。 “阿尔及利亚是欧洲能源安全的核心合作伙伴。天然气供应和可再生能源合作将得到扩大。从长远来看，这是关于建立一条南部氢走廊——从北非到德国，”德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔的发言人塞尔斯廷·加梅林周四在X上发帖称。 阿尔及利亚拥有非洲第二大天然气探明储量，仅次于尼日利亚。它也是非洲最大的天然气生产国。 7月2日，阿尔及利亚国有能源公司Sonatrach将第一批液化天然气（LNG）直接交付至德国威廉港1号浮式液化天然气进口码头。 直接通往德国的管道将消除这些体积的液化、液化天然气运输和再气化的需要。这可以降低天然气输送的运输成本，阿尔及利亚现有的两条通往意大利和西班牙的管道就是这种情况。 伦敦咨询公司Azure Strategy的地缘政治和安全总监爱丽丝·高尔(Alice Gower)表示：“伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡石油出口中断增强了阿尔及利亚的能源重要性。” 她说：“虽然阿尔及利亚无法取代海湾地区的供应，但其管道天然气无需经过海湾航道即可到达南欧，在人们重新担心能源安全之际，为欧洲各国政府提供了供应多元化。” 华盛顿智库史汀生中心北非、地中海和萨赫勒项目主任哈菲德·阿尔·格韦尔（Hafed Al-Ghwell）也赞同这一观点。 Al-Ghwell 告诉德国之声，他最近会见了阿尔及利亚外交部长和内阁成员。 他说：“你可以非常清楚地感觉到，阿尔及利亚政府最高层需要有政治意愿，以利用全球正在发生的事情及其作为主要天然气生产国的独特地位。” 高尔指出，阿尔及利亚对欧洲的价值远远超出了天然气的范围。她告诉德国之声：“阿尔及尔在反恐、移民和地中海稳定方面提供合作。” 多年来，阿尔及利亚一直与欧洲国家合作……

reflection.en: As Algeria navigates complex regional tensions while pursuing international energy partnerships, the need for wise guidance is evident. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that without sound counsel, nations can falter, but through many advisors, safety is found. This highlights the importance of thoughtful leadership and strategic insight when facing multifaceted...
reflection.zh: 当阿尔及利亚在寻求国际能源伙伴关系的同时，应对复杂的地区紧张局势时，对明智指导的需求显而易见。箴言11:14提醒我们，没有健全的谋略，国家就会衰败，但谋士众多，就能得胜。这强调了在面对多方面挑战时，深思熟虑的领导和战略洞察力的重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Spain: Emergency crews battle wildfire north of Madrid
title.zh: 西班牙：紧急救援人员在马德里北部扑灭野火

summary.en: Emergency crews in central Spain are battling a wildfire that has been raging for three days, deploying over 25 firefighting planes to contain the blaze north of Madrid.
summary.zh: 西班牙中部地区的紧急救援人员正在与一场已肆虐三天的野火搏斗，他们已部署超过25架消防飞机，以控制马德里北部的火势。

body.en:
More than 25 firefighting planes have been deployed to battle the blaze in central Spain, which has been raging for three days.

Firefighters battled to contain a fast-spreading wildfire north of Spain's   capital, Madrid , on Sunday.

The country is still reeling from one of the deadliest wildfires  in modern times that killed 13 people and destroyed 7,000 hectares in southern Almeria province earlier this month.

The latest fire started on Thursday in central Spain's Guadalajara province, which includes the Sierra Norte Natural Park.

The area is described as a forest-covered, mountainous region that is home to endangered species, including eagles and wolves.

El Pais newspaper reported that the fire had burned through more than 13,000 hectares by Sunday.

Public broadcaster RTVE reported that the flames had advanced a further 14 kilometers (9 miles) overnight.

More than 500 firefighters and emergency personnel have been deployed to contain the blaze.

Ground crews are also being assisted by 25 firefighting aircraft, officials said.

The head of the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, Emiliano Garcia-Page, paid tribute to emergency workers in a post on X, saying they had "managed to save many lives."

A man, accused of starting the fire, was arrested on Thursday, police said, citing a tipoff from neighbors.

Spain remains on high alert for summer wildfires as a severe drought and low humidity affect much of the country at the height of the tourism season.

A major wildfire earlier this month in Almeria province, in the southern Andalucia region, left 13 people dead, including several foreign nationals.

The country remains in shock after revelations that several of the victims were found in burnt-out vehicles, having failed to flee the flames.

Another wildfire in the northeastern Zaragoza province has been burning since Wednesday, forcing the evacuation of more than a thousand residents.

The regional government warned on Friday evening that the blaze is "far from under control."

However, the head of the Aragon regional government, Jorge Azcon, said Saturday was the "first day we can breathe a sigh of relief," as the fire had been mostly contained.

Since the beginning of the year, wildfires have destroyed more than 80,000 hectares across Spain.

According to the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS), that's nearly double the area burned during the same period last year.

Scientists say human-caused climate change is making heatwaves longer, hotter and more frequent — drying out landscapes and fueling more destructive wildfires.

body.zh: 超过25架消防机已出动扑灭西班牙中部的大火，大火已经肆虐了三天。 周日，消防队员奋力遏制西班牙首都马德里北部迅速蔓延的野火。 该国仍在遭受现代最致命的野火之一的影响，本月早些时候，阿尔梅里亚省南部发生了这场野火，造成 13 人死亡，7,000 公顷土地被毁。 最近的火灾于周四在西班牙中部的瓜达拉哈拉省发生，该省包括北塞拉利昂自然公园。 该地区被描述为森林覆盖的山区，是鹰和狼等濒危物种的家园。 据《国家报》报道，截至周日，大火已烧毁面积超过 13,000 公顷。 公共广播公司 RTVE 报道称，火焰在一夜之间又蔓延了 14 公里（9 英里）。 已部署 500 多名消防员和急救人员来控制火势。 官员称，地勤人员也得到了 25 架消防飞机的协助。 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区政府负责人埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇在 X 上的一篇帖子中向紧急救援人员致敬，称他们“成功拯救了许多生命”。 警方援引邻居举报称，周四逮捕了一名被指控纵火的男子。 西班牙仍对夏季野火保持高度警惕，因为在旅游旺季，严重干旱和低湿度影响了该国大部分地区。 本月早些时候，安达卢西亚南部地区阿尔梅里亚省发生了一场重大山火，造成 13 人死亡，其中包括几名外国人。 数名遇难者被发现在烧毁的车辆中，但未能逃离火焰，该国仍处于震惊之中。 自周三以来，萨拉戈萨省东北部的另一场野火一直在燃烧，迫使一千多名居民撤离。 当地政府周五晚上警告称，火势“远未得到控制”。 然而，阿拉贡地区政府负责人豪尔赫·阿兹康表示，周六是“我们可以松一口气的第一天”，因为火势已基本得到控制。 自今年年初以来，山火已摧毁西班牙全国8万多公顷土地。 根据欧洲森林火灾信息系统（EFFIS）的数据，这几乎是去年同期燃烧面积的两倍。 科学家表示，人为造成的气候变化正在使热浪变得更长、更热、更频繁，导致地表干燥，并助长更具破坏性的野火。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花一点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选新闻来源...

reflection.en: The intense battle against the wildfire in Spain reminds us of creation's vulnerability and its groaning under the weight of brokenness. In such moments, we are called to both diligent action and a deeper understanding of the world's need for restoration.
reflection.zh: 西班牙消防队员与野火的激烈搏斗，提醒我们受造界的脆弱，以及它在破碎重压下的呻吟。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召既要勤勉行动，也要更深地理解世界对复兴的需要。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Fact check: Spotting AI-generated 'historical' images
title.zh: 事实核查：识别AI生成的“历史”图像

summary.en: DW Fact check selected three "historical" videos that aren't real — they're AI. Could you recognize the fake? Here's how to spot it — and why it matters.
summary.zh: 德国之声事实核查栏目挑选了三个并非真实的“历史”视频——它们是由人工智能生成的。你能认出这些假视频吗？本文将介绍如何识别它们以及这为何重要。

body.zh: 德国之声事实调查选择了三个不真实的“历史”视频——它们是人工智能。你能认出假货吗？以下是如何发现它以及它为何如此重要。 在意大利庞贝古城，考古学家首次利用人工智能重建了公元 79 年火山喷发受害者的图像。 随着人工智能技术的广泛应用，人工智能越来越多地被用来生成“历史”图像，而且大多不需要专家的咨询。 苏黎世大学媒体学者罗兰·迈耶 (Roland Meyer) 认为这一趋势并非巧合。 他说：“通过人工智能，似乎可以重新组合过去的图像，生成不存在但可能存在的合成图像，从而填补档案和历史记录中感知或实际的空白。” “然而，对我来说，这似乎是一个欺骗性的承诺。” 众所周知，人工智能生成器会犯错误并产生“幻觉”。 DW 事实核查解释了如何发现 AI 创建的“历史”视频。 许多病毒式传播的人工智能生成的“历史”视频声称展示了过去，模糊了事实与娱乐之间的界限。通常只需询问视频是否可以制作，就可以识别出他们。 “我们是在谈论视频已经存在的时代，还是在视频不存在的时代？”历史学家兼人工智能专家 Sebastian Kubon 问道。 这段据称描绘庞贝古城的视频仅凭这一点就可以被怀疑。 它还显示出人工智能生成的明显迹象。人们的动作就像僵尸一样，而女人的外表看起来比我们所知道的古罗马要现代得多。 人工智能工具的兴起使得创建此类“历史”图像和视频变得比以往任何时候都容易，但专家警告说，人工智能是根据现有数据进行训练的，并且会重复其偏见。 迈耶说：“人工智能生成的过去图像主要再现了迄今为止描绘过去的典型模式、陈词滥调和刻板印象。” “最重要的是，这些是我们期望的图像：不是了解过去的窗口，而是我们现在的镜子。” 其次，仔细研究图像本身及其来源是有帮助的。 在这段视频中，镜头滑近一群举着美国国旗的士兵，露出他们凝视远方的脸。它看起来更像是一部好莱坞电影，而不是真实的纪录片片段。 背景中的一名士兵出现了不自然的故障。水印也暴露了这一点：该视频是由生成式人工智能工具 Veo 制作的。 上述视频取材于 1945 年硫磺岛美军士兵的标志性照片。没有具体的真实视频片段......

reflection.en: In an age where technology can create convincing but false images, the ancient wisdom of Proverbs reminds us to be discerning. We are called to give careful thought to what we encounter, rather than simply believing everything we see or hear. This vigilance helps us navigate a complex information landscape with prudence.
reflection.zh: 在科技能创造出逼真却虚假的图像的时代，箴言的古老智慧提醒我们要有分辨力。我们被呼召要仔细思考所接触到的一切，而不是简单地相信我们所看到或听到的一切。这种警惕性帮助我们审慎地驾驭复杂的信息环境。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: EU ban on destroying unsold clothes takes effect
title.zh: 欧盟禁止销毁未售衣物生效

summary.en: New regulations in the European Union now prohibit large companies from discarding unsold clothing, accessories, and footwear as part of efforts to reduce waste.
summary.zh: 根据新规定，欧盟范围内的大公司不得再丢弃未售出的衣物、配饰和鞋类，以减少浪费。

body.en:
Under new rules to reduce waste, large companies across the European Union can no longer dispose of unsold clothes, accessories and footwear.

A ban on the disposal of unsold clothes and shoes took effect across the European Union on Sunday, in the bloc's latest move to cut waste.

Hundreds of thousands of tons of fashionwear are destroyed every year across the 27-member EU due to damage, old stock and returned online orders.

The new rule is expected to affect large fashion retailers, wholesalers and manufacturers of apparel — only 20% of which are produced in the EU.

Under the EU's Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation, large companies with more than 250 employees and over €50 million in net annual turnover are banned from destroying stocks of unsold clothing, accessories and footwear.

Firms must now find ways of selling the products, including via discounts, alternative markets and charity donations.

Unsold clothes can only be destroyed when items are unsafe, damaged, counterfeit or rejected by charities, according to a post on the European Commission's website.

Companies are now required to publish annual reports on the goods they have discarded and keep records for five years.

The regulation, which was approved by Brussels more than two years ago, will be extended to medium-sized firms in 2030.

Concerns about so-called fast fashion — low-cost, lower-quality mass-produced clothing — have grown significantly over the past decade.

According to the European Environment Agency (EEA), around 4% to 9% of unsold textile products are destroyed each year.

Across the EU, one in five fashion goods ordered online is later returned to the retailer and not resold.

Combined, this amounts to hundreds of thousands of tons of clothes, accessories and footwear.

The new ban aims to help reduce the impact on the environment , as the incineration of millions of clothes hits efforts to cut greenhouse gas emissions.

EU states are also under pressure to consider waste from raw materials, water, energy and transport in the apparel sector and to encourage more recycling and the reuse of products.

In a recent LinkedIn post, the EEA said the bloc wanted the textile industry to become more sustainable.

"A circular economy — where products are designed to last, and are reused, repaired and recycled — is no longer just a vision, but is being embedded in law through these new legislative measures," the EEA wrote.

The fashion industry has repeatedly defended its tactics, noting that disposal is often cheaper than storing, repairing or discounting the products.

body.zh: 根据减少浪费的新规定，欧盟各地的大公司不能再处理未售出的衣服、配饰和鞋类。 周日，欧盟范围内禁止处理未售出的衣服和鞋子的禁令生效，这是欧盟减少浪费的最新举措。 在欧盟 27 个成员国中，每年有数十万吨时装因损坏、旧库存和网上订单退货而被销毁。 新规定预计将影响大型时装零售商、批发商和服装制造商——其中只有 20% 是在欧盟生产的。 根据欧盟可持续产品生态设计法规，员工超过 250 名、年净营业额超过 5000 万欧元的大公司被禁止销毁未售出的服装、配饰和鞋类库存。 企业现在必须找到销售产品的方式，包括通过折扣、替代市场和慈善捐赠。 根据欧盟委员会网站上的一篇文章，只有当物品不安全、损坏、伪造或被慈善机构拒绝时，未售出的衣服才会被销毁。 现在，公司必须公布其丢弃的货物的年度报告，并保存记录五年。 该法规于两年多前获得布鲁塞尔批准，将于 2030 年扩展到中型企业。 过去十年，人们对所谓的快时尚（低成本、低质量的批量生产服装）的担忧显着增长。 根据欧洲环境署 (EEA) 的数据，每年约有 4% 至 9% 的未售出纺织品被销毁。 在整个欧盟，网上订购的时尚商品有五分之一随后被退回零售商而不是转售。 加起来，这相当于数十万吨的衣服、配饰和鞋类。 新禁令旨在帮助减少对环境的影响，因为焚烧数百万件衣服会影响减少温室气体排放的努力。 欧盟国家还面临压力，需要考虑服装行业中原材料、水、能源和运输产生的废物，并鼓励更多的产品回收和再利用。 在最近的 LinkedIn 帖子中，欧洲经济区表示，该集团希望纺织业变得更加可持续。 欧洲经济区写道：“循环经济——产品的设计经久耐用，并可重复使用、修理和回收——不再只是一个愿景，而是通过这些新的立法措施被纳入法律。” 时尚界一再为其策略辩护，指出处理产品通常比储存、修理或打折产品便宜。 德国零售联合会（HDE）表示，随着更多……消费者将从禁令中受益。

reflection.en: This new regulation reminds us of our ancient calling to be good stewards of creation. By preventing the destruction of usable goods, societies can better honor the resources and labor invested, reflecting a deeper care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.

title.en: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate arrested in US on new charges, face extradition
title.zh: 网红安德鲁·泰特和特里斯坦·泰特在美国因新指控被捕，面临引渡

summary.en: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate have been arrested in the US on new charges and are now facing extradition to the United Kingdom.
summary.zh: 知名网红安德鲁·泰特和特里斯坦·泰特在美国因新指控被捕，目前正面临被引渡到英国。

body.en:
Radical social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate have been arrested in the United States as British authorities seek their extradition on rape and sex trafficking charges.

The brothers' social media empire promoting wealth, male dominance and misogyny has made them among the world's most polarising internet personalities.

The US Marshals Service confirmed the arrest of 39-year-old Andrew Tate, a self-professed misogynist, and his younger brother on a sealed warrant, placing the US at the centre of an international legal saga that has stretched from Romania to Britain.

US news outlet TMZ posted a video of law enforcement officers placing the men in handcuffs and escorting them into waiting vehicles. Asked by an onlooker if he had something to say, Tristan Tate did not respond, the footage posted on social media platform X showed.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

British prosecutors said on Sunday they were prosecuting Andrew Tate with seven further counts of rape, three counts of facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation, three counts of assault and 19 additional charges for offences relating to indecent images of a child and extreme pornography. He has already been charged previously for 10 counts of rape, assault and human trafficking.

Tristan Tate had been charged with an six more counts of sexual assault, rape and facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation. He already has 11 previous charges for the same crimes.

British prosecutors seeking the brothers' extradition alleging they conducted these offences between 2010 and 2017.

They were arrested there in 2022, accused of participating in schemes to lure women for sexual exploitation. They denied those allegations and the case didn't go forward because of legal and procedural irregularities.

The pending charges in the United Kingdom accused the brothers of abusing women in an area north of London, where they grew up. Their lawyers had said they denied the allegations.

Joseph McBride, a lawyer representing the Tate brothers, said in a phone interview he had not been able to speak with his clients but called the new charges out of the UK "filth and slander" intended to derail defamation lawsuits filed by the brothers in the US.

"They're pulling out all the stops to make sure these guys never get their day in court," McBride said.

"We are confident that once a competent judge sees the facts, and once the Department of Justice confronts this egregious abuse of its own authority, Andrew and Tristan Tate will walk free. America does not do Britain's political dirty work."

title.en: Food delivery rider wins China's top literary prize
title.zh: 外卖骑手荣获中国最高文学奖

summary.en: Wang Jibing, a food delivery rider, has been awarded China's most prestigious literary prize. His achievement highlights a growing trend of blue-collar workers in China gaining recognition for their literary contributions.
summary.zh: 外卖骑手王计兵荣获中国最高文学奖。他的成就凸显了中国蓝领工人因其文学作品而获得更广泛关注的趋势。

body.en:
A collection of poems, some scribbled on slips of paper between food deliveries, has won Wang Jibing one of China's top literary honours.

Low Flight, inspired by the everyday challenges delivery riders face, has bagged the Lu Xun Literary Prize - named after a writer who has been referred to as the father of modern Chinese literature.

Wang, 56, who became a delivery rider around 2019, gained traction on social media for his poems and essays.

He is part of a growing group of blue-collar workers who are being celebrated for their literary works, which offer a glimpse into the pressures that they face in China's massive gig economy.

For Wang, the prestigious literary prize comes after a few difficult decades as an odd job worker.

"I held my breath and felt extremely nervous… Once it was revealed, everything was settled," Wang told state media outlet Global Times on 15 July, when news broke that he had won the award - adding that the media attention around him had created a lot of mental pressure on him.

The monetary awards for recipients of the Lu Xun Literary Prize are not publicly announced - though as of 2014 it stood at 100,000 Chinese yuan ($14,800; £11,000).

Born in Jiangsu province, Wang left school as a teenager due to financial hardship at home. He took on various jobs, from construction to scavenging for waste and selling things at a street stall, before becoming a food deliveryman.

But his love for reading persisted, and over the last decade he has been posting his own poems and essays on social media.

In 2022, one of his poems, titled Man in a Hurry, went viral online. It was inspired by a incident in 2019, in which he spent hours on a frustrating delivery after a customer entered the wrong address.

In 2023 he published his first poetry collection, Man in a Hurry: Poems of a Food Delivery Rider.

Despite winning the award, Wang told the outlet he had no intention of quitting his job, adding that he planned to work until he turns 60.

"Financially I don't need this job to make a living, but I love the vibe of the work and it keeps me fit," said the Global Times report. "I want a down-to-earth life and the award will never change who I am."

Low Flight, published in 2024, is a collection of poems inspired by interviews and surveys that Wang conducted with around 200 delivery riders.

"Who says spreading your wings means flying high? Flying low is also flying," goes one of the lines in his poems.

His win comes as a growing number of blue worker collars in China have in recent years been making their mark in the literary world.

I Deliver Parcels in Beijing, a 2023 memoir by former courier Hu Anyan, became a runaway bestseller in China and also captured media attention abroad. An English translation of the memoir was published last...
body.zh: 王吉兵的一本诗集（其中一些是在送餐期间写在纸条上的）为他赢得了中国最高文学荣誉之一。 《低空飞行》的灵感来自于外卖骑手每天面临的挑战，它获得了鲁迅文学奖——以一位被称为中国现代文学之父的作家的名字命名。 王现年 56 岁，2019 年左右成为一名送货骑手，他的诗歌和散文在社交媒体上受到关注。 他是越来越多的蓝领工人群体中的一员，这些工人因其文学作品而受到赞誉，这让人们得以一窥他们在中国庞大的零工经济中面临的压力。 对于王来说，享有盛誉的文学奖是在他作为打零工经历了几十年艰难的生活之后获得的。 7月15日，当他获奖的消息传出时，王告诉官方媒体《环球时报》：“我屏住呼吸，感到非常紧张……一旦揭晓，一切就都解决了。”他还补充说，周围媒体的关注给他带来了很大的精神压力。 鲁迅文学奖获奖者的奖金并未公开公布，但截至 2014 年，奖金为 10 万元人民币（14,800 美元；11,000 英镑）。 王出生于江苏省，青少年时期因家庭经济困难而辍学。在成为一名送餐员之前，他从事过各种工作，从建筑到清理垃圾，再到在街边摊上卖东西。 但他对阅读的热爱始终如一，在过去的十年里，他一直在社交媒体上发布自己的诗歌和散文。 2022年，他的一首诗《匆忙的男人》在网上疯传。它的灵感来自 2019 年的一次事件，当时一位顾客输入了错误的地址，他花了几个小时处理令人沮丧的送货事宜。 2023年，他出版了第一部诗集《匆忙的人：送餐骑手的诗》。 尽管获奖，王告诉媒体他无意辞职，并补充说他计划工作到 60 岁。 《环球时报》报道称：“从经济上来说，我不需要这份工作来谋生，但我喜欢这份工作的氛围，它让我保持健康。” “我想要脚踏实地的生活，这个奖项永远不会改变我是谁。” 《低空飞行》于 2024 年出版，是一本诗集，灵感来自于王对约 200 名送货骑手进行的采访和调查。 “谁说展翅高飞？低飞也是飞翔。”他的诗中有这样一句话。 他的获奖之际，近年来，越来越多的中国蓝领工人在文学界崭露头角。 前快递员胡安彦于 2023 年出版的回忆录《我在北京送包裹》在中国成为畅销书，也引起了海外媒体的关注。该回忆录的英文译本于去年出版......

reflection.en: This story reminds us that every form of honest labor holds dignity, and talent can emerge from any walk of life. Yahweh calls us to approach all our work, no matter how humble, with diligence and excellence, as if serving Him directly. Such dedication often reveals hidden gifts and brings unexpected honor.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，每一种诚实的劳动都具有尊严，才能可以从各行各业中涌现。雅伟呼召我们以勤勉和卓越的态度对待我们所有的工作，无论多么卑微，如同直接服事他一样。这种奉献常常会显露隐藏的恩赐，并带来意想不到的荣耀。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

body.en: Startling new research shows that in many countries – including old US allies – the public prefers Beijing to Washington Earlier this year, a spate of western TikTok and Instagram creators announced that they were at “a very Chinese time in my life” – drinking hot water and wearing slippers around their homes. The Chinamaxxing phenomenon primarily reflected the constant need of influencers for novel content. But social media trends also reflect a growing fascination with China, as the economic historian Adam Tooze has noted . While it broods over China’s economic, military and technical advance, the Trump administration is accelerating Beijing’s diplomatic progress, as striking new polling by the Pew Research Center shows. For the first time, China and Xi Jinping are seen more favourably than the US and its president in most of the 36 major countries surveyed – including Canada, Mexico and Australia. Only in six countries did people rate the US more highly. While Beijing has seen significant improvements in some places, the slump in Washington’s standing is more dramatic. Across 20 countries, the median percentage with a favourable view of China rose from 32% to 46% between 2023 and this year; for the US, it fell from 58% to 36%. Views of China were much more positive in Latin America, Africa and parts of south and south-east Asia than in wealthier European and east Asian countries. Continue reading...
body.zh: 令人震惊的新研究表明，在许多国家 — — 包括美国的老盟友 — — 公众更喜欢北京而不是华盛顿。 今年早些时候，一大批西方 TikTok 和 Instagram 创作者宣布，他们正处于“我一生中非常中国化的时期”——喝着热水，在家中穿着拖鞋。 Chinamaxshing现象主要反映了网红对新颖内容的持续需求。但正如经济历史学家亚当·图兹（Adam Tooze）指出的那样，社交媒体趋势也反映出人们对中国日益增长的迷恋。皮尤研究中心令人震惊的最新民意调查显示，在关注中国经济、军事和技术进步的同时，特朗普政府正在加速北京的外交进展。在接受调查的 36 个主要国家（包括加拿大、墨西哥和澳大利亚）中，大多数国家对中国和习近平的好感度首次高于美国及其总统。只有六个国家的人们对美国的评价更高。尽管北京在某些方面取得了显着进步，但华盛顿的地位下滑更为严重。 2023 年至今，20 个国家对中国持好感的中位数百分比从 32% 上升至 46%；美国则从 58% 下降至 36%。拉丁美洲、非洲以及南亚和东南亚部分地区对中国的看法比富裕的欧洲和东亚国家要积极得多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The shifting global perceptions of superpowers, as highlighted in the news, remind us that a nation's true standing is often tied to its character and actions. Proverbs 14:34 suggests that righteousness elevates a people, while moral failings can bring disgrace. This perspective encourages us to consider how nations, like individuals, are ultimately judged...
reflection.zh: 新闻中强调的全球对超级大国看法的转变，提醒我们一个国家真正的地位往往与其品格和行为息息相关。箴言14:34指出，公义使邦国高举，罪恶是人民的羞辱。这一视角鼓励我们思考，国家如同个人，最终会因其正直和所体现的价值观而受到评判。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

When leaders govern with integrity and truth, society flourishes; when they do not,...

title.en: China firm seeks damages over state control of British Steel
title.zh: 中国公司就英国钢铁国有化寻求赔偿

summary.en: China's Jingye Group is seeking compensation from the UK government after the government took over British Steel last year. The UK government intervened to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility, which Jingye Group had purchased in 2020.
summary.zh: 中国敬业集团正向英国政府寻求赔偿，此前英国政府去年接管了英国钢铁公司，以防止该国最后一个主要炼钢设施关闭。敬业集团于2020年收购了该公司。

body.en:
The UK government took over British Steel last year to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility. China's Jingye Group, which bought the firm in 2020, claims it is owed compensation.

A Chinese steel giant demanded compensation from the United Kingdom   government on Sunday, claiming the state's takeover of its subsidiary, British Steel, was "outright robbery."

The UK government took operational control of British Steel last year, after owner Jingye Group warned that Britain's last factory capable of making steel from scratch was no longer financially viable.

In a statement on social media, Jingye threatened legal action against the UK government, accusing ministers of "trampling on international investment rules."

Describing the nationalization as "outright robbery," the Chinese firm said it "reserves all legal rights, firmly defends its lawful rights and interests, and will pursue full compensation through legal means to the very end."

"The UK disregarded Jingye's continuous investment and significant contribution and was only willing to provide almost zero compensation,” the statement continued.

The company noted that nationalization could cost UK taxpayers more than 1.5 billion pounds ($2.02 billion, €1.76 billion) by 2028.

Jingye said it had begun a procedure under bilateral investment agreements to seek damages, without expanding further.

China's Foreign Ministry backed the compensation move, calling on the UK to "earnestly respect market principles and the spirit of contract, and find solutions on compensation and other issues acceptable to both sides."

After Jingye last year planned to close the blast furnaces at its plant in Scunthorpe, in northern England, the UK government passed emergency measures, allowing it to take  operational control of British Steel .

The immediate concern was that the blast furnaces would be shut permanently, ending the UK's capacity to produce virgin or primary steel from raw materials. The plant accounts for the vast majority of British Steel's operations.

The government cited national security for the move, which came five years after Jingye bought British Steel from a London-based private equity firm for around 70 million pounds.

Ministers cited the need to protect strategic steel supplies for construction, rail infrastructure and defense.

The move was also seen as a way to protect thousands of jobs in a deprived area of the UK. The Scunthorpe plant currently employs about 2,700 people.

In recent weeks, the UK Parliament has passed legislation that allowed the government on Thursday to bring British Steel into full public ownership.

body.zh: 英国政府去年接管了英国钢铁公司，以防止该国最后一个主要炼钢厂关闭。于 2020 年收购该公司的中国敬业集团声称其被欠赔偿。 周日，一家中国钢铁巨头要求英国政府赔偿，声称英国政府对其子公司英国钢铁公司的收购是“彻头彻尾的抢劫”。 去年，英国政府接管了英国钢铁公司的运营控制权，此前其所有者敬业集团警告称，英国最后一家能够从头开始生产钢铁的工厂不再具有财务可行性。 在周六社交媒体上的一份声明中，敬业威胁要对英国政府采取法律行动，指责部长们“践踏国际投资规则”。 这家中国公司将此次国有化描述为“彻头彻尾的抢劫”，并表示“保留一切合法权利，坚决捍卫合法权益，并将通过法律手段追究到底”。 声明还说：“英国无视敬业公司的持续投资和重大贡献，只愿意提供几乎为零的补偿。” 该公司指出，到 2028 年，国有化可能会让英国纳税人损失超过 15 亿英镑（20.2 亿美元，17.6 亿欧元）。 敬业表示，已根据双边投资协议启动了寻求损害赔偿的程序，但没有进一步扩大范围。 中国外交部支持这一赔偿举措，呼吁英方“切实尊重市场原则和契约精神，就赔偿等问题找到双方都能接受的解决方案”。 去年敬业计划关闭位于英格兰北部斯肯索普工厂的高炉后，英国政府通过了紧急措施，允许其对英国钢铁公司进行运营控制。 当务之急是高炉将永久关闭，从而结束英国利用原材料生产原生钢的能力。该工厂占英国钢铁公司业务的绝大多数。 政府以国家安全为由采取了这一举措，五年前敬业以约 7000 万英镑从一家伦敦私募股权公司手中收购了英国钢铁公司 (British Steel)。 部长们指出有必要保护建筑、铁路基础设施和国防的战略钢铁供应。 此举也被视为保护英国贫困地区数千个就业岗位的一种方式。 斯肯索普工厂目前拥有约 2,700 名员工。 最近几周，英国议会通过了一项立法，允许政府于周四将英国钢铁公司完全纳入公有制。 根据新法律，独立评估师必须评估是否有...

reflection.en: When governments intervene in economic affairs, the call for justice and righteousness remains paramount. Yahweh's word reminds leaders to act fairly, ensuring that all parties, including investors, are treated equitably and not unjustly deprived. This principle encourages thoughtful consideration of compensation and fair dealings in complex situations...
reflection.zh: 当政府干预经济事务时，对公义和正直的呼吁至关重要。雅伟的话语提醒领导者要公正行事，确保包括投资者在内的所有各方都受到公平对待，不被不公正地剥夺。这一原则鼓励在涉及国家利益和私营企业的复杂情况下，深思熟虑赔偿和公平交易。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Trump, not Iran, is the world’s greatest danger. He’s a one-man weapon of mass destruction | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 特朗普，而非伊朗，是世界上最大的危险。他是一个人的大规模杀伤性武器 | 西蒙·蒂斯代尔

summary.en: The article argues that the US president's actions have initiated a disastrous war and an economic quagmire, leading to a "limitless fiasco" as bombing resumes. It characterizes the president as "feckless and clueless," unable to navigate or exit the conflict he started.
summary.zh: 文章指出，随着轰炸再次开始，美国总统的行为已将美国拖入一场无止境的灾难和经济泥潭。文章形容这位总统“无能又糊涂”，无法摆脱他所发动的这场灾难性战争。

body.en: As the bombing starts again, it’s clear the president has dragged the US into a limitless fiasco – and the world into an economic quagmire Feckless and clueless, Donald Trump is lost in Iran, unable to find a way out of the disastrous war he started. Once again, the US military is pummelling the country and, increasingly, its civilian infrastructure. As before, this unlawful bludgeoning strengthens the resistance of a hardline regime that cares little for its people’s suffering. How often have Trump and Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon’s wildling lord of bones, hailed a bogus victory? The president claimed this week to be “winning big”. No one believes him. Even as it counts the vast human and economic cost of his Persian folly, a watching world scoffs at US impotence. Control of the strait of Hormuz, closed due to Trump’s belligerence, is now the White House’s limited, elusive objective. The grander US and Israeli war aims – eliminating Iran’s nuclear programme, degrading its regional militias, regime change – are less attainable than ever. It’s Trump’s craven leadership that renders US forces ineffective, not the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. If Iran really is the existential menace he claims, the logical course would be all-out conquest. When George W Bush decided Iraq posed unacceptable dangers, he invaded with 170,000 ground troops. It was a catastrophe. But at least Bush had balls. Simon Tisdall is a Guardian foreign affairs commentator Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着轰炸再次开始，很明显，总统已将美国拖入了无限的惨败 — — 并将世界拖入了经济泥潭。 无能又无能的唐纳德·特朗普在伊朗迷失了方向，无法找到摆脱他发起的灾难性战争的出路。美国军队再次对该国进行打击，并越来越多地打击其民用基础设施。和以前一样，这种非法的殴打加强了一个不关心人民苦难的强硬政权的抵抗。特朗普和五角大楼的野人骸骨领主皮特·赫格斯多少次欢呼一场虚假的胜利？总统本周声称“大获全胜”。没有人相信他。尽管他的波斯愚蠢行为造成了巨大的人力和经济成本，但全世界都在嘲笑美国的无能。控制因特朗普的好战而关闭的霍尔木兹海峡，现在已成为白宫有限且难以捉摸的目标。美国和以色列更宏伟的战争目标——消除伊朗核计划、削弱其地区民兵、政权更迭——比以往任何时候都更难以实现。导致美军效率低下的是特朗普胆怯的领导，而不是伊斯兰革命卫队。如果伊朗确实是他所声称的生存威胁，那么合乎逻辑的路线将是全面征服。当乔治·W·布什认定伊拉克构成了无法接受的危险时，他派遣了 17 万地面部队入侵。这是一场灾难。但至少布什有胆量。西蒙·蒂斯达尔是卫报外交事务评论员继续阅读...

reflection.en: This proverb reminds us of the profound and often devastating impact that leaders can have on their people and the world. When those in power act recklessly or without wisdom, the consequences can be like a destructive force, leaving nations in turmoil and people vulnerable. It underscores the heavy responsibility of leadership and the need for discernment...
reflection.zh: 这句箴言提醒我们，领袖对他们的人民和世界可能产生深刻而往往是毁灭性的影响。当掌权者鲁莽行事或缺乏智慧时，其后果可能像一股破坏性的力量，使国家陷入混乱，人民变得脆弱。它强调了领导的重任以及对执政者保持明辨的重要性。

verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

May we seek leaders whose actions foster unity and trust, reflecting...

reflection.zh: 在公共讨论中，最初的说法往往听起来很有说服力，直到它们被彻底审查。这个故事提醒我们，仔细审查和听取各方意见的重要性，尤其是在提出严重指控时。雅伟鼓励我们寻求智慧，不要轻信每一个说法。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Beijing’s message to the world’s tourists: come here and judge China for yourselves | Zichen Wang
title.zh: 北京向世界游客发出信息：来中国，亲自评判

summary.en: Beijing has relaxed its visa rules, aiming to boost its economy and enhance its international image. The move has led to a noticeable return of foreign tourists to the capital, engaging in sightseeing and local activities.
summary.zh: 北京放宽了签证规定，旨在提振经济并改善其国际形象。此举已使外国游客明显回流首都，他们正在观光并参与当地活动。

body.en: By relaxing visa rules, Beijing has two things on its mind – boosting its economy and improving its self-image Walk through central Beijing today and one thing quickly becomes apparent: foreigners are back. They are taking photos outside the Forbidden City and sitting in cafes around Gulou and Sanlitun. The shift is visible online, too; YouTube is increasingly filled with videos titled “China Shocked Me” or “My First Week in China”. Most of the creators are tourists, not China specialists or journalists, and many of them are encountering the country for the first time. The resurgence is striking because to many outside observers China’s story has become one of closure and increased security – of intensifying strategic rivalry with the west, expanded anti-espionage enforcement and increasingly constrained foreign reporting, including the withholding and revocation of visas for US journalists. Yet on the ground, another story is unfolding. When it comes to its relationship with the rest of the world, Beijing increasingly appears to be betting on direct exposure: come to China and judge for yourself. Zichen Wang is deputy secretary-general at the Center for China and Globalization, a thinktank in Beijing. This article was co-written by Hao Wu, an assistant professor at the School of International Studies at Peking University Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 通过放宽签证规定，北京有两件事要考虑——提振经济和改善自我形象。今天漫步在北京市中心，一件事很快就会变得显而易见：外国人回来了。他们在故宫外拍照，坐在鼓楼和三里屯周围的咖啡馆里。这种转变在网上也可见一斑。 YouTube 上越来越多地充斥着标题为“中国让我震惊”或“我在中国的第一周”的视频。大多数创作者都是游客，而不是中国专家或记者，而且他们中的许多人都是第一次接触这个国家。这种复苏令人震惊，因为对许多外部观察家来说，中国的故事已经变成了封闭和安全增强的故事 — — 与西方的战略竞争加剧、反间谍执法扩大以及对外报道日益受到限制，包括扣留和吊销美国记者的签证。然而，在地面上，另一个故事正在上演。当谈到与世界其他国家的关系时，北京似乎越来越倾向于直接曝光：来中国自己判断。王子晨是北京智库中国与全球化智库的副秘书长。本文由北京大学国际关系学院助理教授吴浩共同撰写，您对本文提出的问题有何看法？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: By inviting tourists to "judge China for yourselves," Beijing seeks to bridge gaps in understanding and perception. This echoes a deeper human longing to dismantle barriers and foster connection, reminding us that Yahweh desires for dividing walls of hostility to be broken down. Such direct encounters, even for economic reasons, can open pathways for...
reflection.zh: 北京邀请游客“亲自评判中国”，旨在弥合理解和认知上的鸿沟。这呼应了人类拆除隔阂、促进联结的深层渴望，提醒我们雅伟渴望拆毁敌意的隔墙。即使是出于经济原因，这种直接的接触也能为各民族之间更深的相互理解开辟道路。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: ICE arrests human rights lawyer who fled Chinese crackdown
title.zh: 美国移民和海关执法局逮捕一名逃离中国镇压的人权律师
